tools.name: rainbow-maker-tool-20261023.json
tools.description: Give a group of surfaces the Rainbow Maker's cut-crystal glass: select objects in Unity and one menu puts the UnityUnicorn/RainbowMakerGlass material on every renderer (three-colour refraction read from the room's reflection probe, sun sparkle, tint and sliders). A Blender script applies the same three-glass crystal for renders and exports. Material only; geometry is the geographic-statue-converter's job.
tools.command_template: Unity menu: Tools > Unity Unicorn > rainbow-maker-tool > Make selection crystal. Blender: blender --background --python scripts/rainbow-maker-tool/rainbow-maker-tool-20261023.py -- --mesh "<file>" --out "<folder>" --render
requirements: Unity 2022.3 Built-in Render Pipeline; install the editor script and rainbow-maker-tool-20261023.shader.
A baked reflection probe in the room for the glass to look through.
